summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Hong Kong exchange announcement) disclosing a grant of 1,638,591 RSUs on October 9, 2026, to 124 employees under its 2026 Share Scheme, equal to 0.38% of issued shares excluding treasury. The purchase price is nil, with reference prices of HK$45.38 per Class A share and US$5.76 per ADS. Vesting is 25% at the first anniversary of September 30, 2026 for 1,626,091 RSUs with quarterly remainder over four years, and 50% over two years for 12,500 RSUs. No performance targets apply; clawback terms apply. This is routine equity compensation and not a special situation.
